request.style: English, bright male solo with children choir, acoustic guitar, piano, flute, harp, strings, warm and joyful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He led me to the temple gate
Water flowed out to the east
From under the threshold below
It ran down from the altar's base

[Chorus]
Water for healing
Fresh from the shrine
Making the stagnant sea
Become fresh and clean

[Verse]
With a measuring line in hand
He walked a thousand cubits
The water reached my ankles
Then up to my knees
Another thousand steps
It came up to my waist
Now it is a deep river
Too deep to cross

[Chorus]
Water for healing
Fresh from the shrine
Making the stagnant sea
Become fresh and clean

[Bridge]
Trees on both banks grow tall
Their leaves will not wither away
Fresh fruit every single month
Because water flows from God

[Outro]
Fruit for food and leaves for healing
The Holy River flows
